result.title: Quantizing Recurrent Language Models Is Easier Than You Think
result.summary: Linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models, replacing the growing KV cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. However, the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax Transformers, whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. Our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. In our analysis, we differentiate between two targets. First, extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state, whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. In controlled 1.3B parameter models, we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. Second, intra-state quantization concerns the recurrent state itself during decode, where repeated updates create a different numerical problem from KV cache quantization. We instantiate our findings as LoReS, a state quantization pipeline combining value-axis scale grouping to match output channel magnitude, decay-based mixed-precision to protect slowly decaying heads or channels, and stochastic rounding to limit error accumulation under repeated requantization. Across Qwen-3.5 9B, Nemotron-H 8B, and Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B, LoReS supports robust 8-bit state quantization and lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons. We implement LoReS in vLLM and demonstrate end-to-end decode speedups.

AI.brief_summary: 研究线性循环语言模型的量化设计空间，区分循环状态之外的权重/激活量化与解码时循环状态自身的量化，发现衰减型循环的残差离群通道弱于 softmax 注意力、更易量化，并提出 LoReS（值轴分组缩放、按衰减的混合精度、随机舍入）实现 8-bit 状态量化与端到端解码加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其针对循环状态反复更新下误差累积的量化设计（衰减驱动的混合精度、随机舍入）可能为 latent 推理状态的数值保真与信息坍缩提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
